review.01.title: Way better than Gmail!
review.01.author: soda_cowboy
review.01.body: I can’t believe how smooth this app runs. Really terrific ai integration too. Excited to see how it develops.

review.02.title: Fast, thoughtful, and delightful
review.02.author: JamesL55
review.02.body: I’ve been using Avec throughout the beta, and it quickly became my default email app. The experience is fast, focused, and thoughtfully designed in a way that makes other email apps feel slow by comparison. This is one of the few email apps that actually makes email feel lighter.

review.03.title: The only way to handle email
review.03.author: evntylr
review.03.body: Email has always been awful. I monitor 8 email accounts, and it sucks. I have tried every single product in the category, and Avec is the very first that has actually made a difference; I don’t think I can go back to regular email. I can’t wait to see what is next from the Avec team!

review.04.title: The best email app
review.04.author: BUGGSSSSSS!!!!!
review.04.body: Avec makes managing your inbox insanely easy. Some of my favorite features are notifications that include a really accurate summary so a new message is glanceable and the ability to speak when drafting or searching.

review.05.title: Smoothest emailing experience
review.05.author: Rudraksh Awasthi
review.05.body: With all the emailing apps stuck in 2015, avec makes that experience smoother and more modern. Love the miscellaneous emails at the end of the stack and the most convenient unsubscribe feature.

review.06.title: Hate managing email? Me too!
review.06.author: Vahwdsss
review.06.body: Avec has saved me so much time managing email. It’s easily the best email app out there and I’ve tried them all. I’m sure Superhuman wishes they were Avec.

reviews.title: Calm at last
reviews.author: Ines R.
reviews.body: I used to dread the morning pile. Now it is a short stack and a clear head. Sample review for layout only.

reviews.title: Quick and quiet
reviews.author: Tobias W.
reviews.body: Replying by voice saves my thumbs on the commute, and the drafts sound like me. Sample review for layout only.

reviews.title: Finds things fast
reviews.author: Keiko M.
reviews.body: Searching by describing the message works every time I try it. Sample review for layout only.
